description: Sequence and functional annotation for a protein: UniProt positional features (domains, binding and active sites, PTMs including cross-links and lipidation, topology, DNA binding, processing products such as chains and signal peptides, mutagenesis), natural variants, and InterPro domain/family memberships (Pfam, PROSITE, …) with GO terms. Provide a canonical UniProt accession directly, or a PDB ID — it is resolved to its UniProt accession via the structure's sequence cross-reference. A multi-chain PDB entry can map to several accessions; the default pick is deterministic (lowest author chain ID) and the alternatives are listed in "ambiguity" — pass "chain" to select a specific one. An accession UniProt merged into another entry answers for that successor with a notice; a demerged or deleted one fails with its replacement accessions. Use "include" to scope which annotation classes are fetched. Every response carries an "attribution" block with the upstream data licenses and citations.

chain.description: Author chain ID (auth_asym_id, e.g. "A") that disambiguates a multi-chain PDB entry to a specific UniProt accession. Case-sensitive — must match the author chain ID exactly (large structures can carry distinct "A" and "a" chains). Only applies with pdb_id; ignored when uniprot is supplied directly. See polymerEntities[].authAsymIds in the pdb://{entry_id} resource for an entry's author chain IDs.

domains_offset.description: Zero-based offset into InterPro memberships; independent of features and variants.

features_offset.description: Zero-based offset into functional features; independent of variants and domains.

include.description: Which annotation classes to fetch: features, domains (InterPro), variants, or all.

limit.description: Per-class page size (1–200, default 50). Continue each class independently with features_offset, variants_offset, or domains_offset; the notice gives the next offset.

pdb_id.description: PDB entry ID; resolved to a UniProt accession via cross-reference.

uniprot.description: Canonical UniProt accession (e.g. P69905). Isoform accessions (e.g. P04637-2) are rejected; UniProt annotates the canonical entry. Takes precedence over pdb_id.

variants_offset.description: Zero-based offset into natural variants; independent of features and domains.

name: protein_get_annotations

accession.description: UniProt accession the annotations describe — the successor when UniProt merged the requested accession, which the notice names.

ambiguity.description: Alternative UniProt mappings when a PDB ID resolved ambiguously (no chain given).

accessions.description: Every distinct UniProt mapping for the entry, lowest-chain first.

items.description: One chain-group → UniProt accession mapping within the entry.

accession.description: UniProt accession the chains map to.

chain.description: Author chain IDs (auth_asym_id) this entity covers (e.g. ["A", "C"]).

notice.description: Why multiple mappings exist and how to select one via the chain input.

attribution.description: Upstream data-source licenses and citations for every source that contributed to this response. Always present — the attribution obligation travels with the data.

items.description: Upstream data-source attribution: license, citation, and homepage.

citation.description: Primary-literature citation to credit the source.

license.description: License the source data is released under (e.g. "CC BY 4.0").

source.description: Contributing data-source display name (e.g. "RCSB PDB", "AlphaFold DB", "SWISS-MODEL", "UniProt"). Open-ended — best_available structures are federated through 3D-Beacons providers.

items.description: An InterPro domain/family membership with GO terms.

locations.description: Separate locations for this membership on the requested UniProt protein.

items.description: One InterPro location on the requested protein.

fragments.description: Ordered fragments within this location, when supplied.

items.description: One domain fragment; gaps between fragments are not part of the domain.

domainsTotal.description: InterPro's membership count for the protein; present only when requested. When InterPro paging stopped short of it, the notice names how many memberships domains_offset can reach.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_identifier`: Neither uniprot nor pdb_id was supplied, so there is no protein to look up. `invalid_accession`: The supplied uniprot value is not a canonical UniProt accession: malformed, or an isoform accession (e.g. P04637-2), which UniProt does not annotate apart from its canonical entry. `accession_not_found`: UniProtKB has no entry for a well-formed accession: it was never assigned. `inactive_accession`: UniProt lists the accession as inactive: demerged into several entries, or deleted. `no_uniprot_mapping`: A supplied PDB ID resolved to no usable UniProt cross-reference (e.g. a nucleic-acid-only entry). `chain_not_found`: A supplied chain matches no UniProt-mapped polymer entity in the resolved PDB entry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

features.description: Positional features other than natural variants, in UniProt order (grouped by type). Secondary structure, isoform sequences, and sequence-record notes are not included.

items.description: A sequence feature or natural variant over a residue range.

alternativeSequences.description: Source-provided alternatives, preserving order and empty values; absence does not assert a deletion.

featureId.description: Stable UniProt feature identifier when supplied.

originalSequence.description: Source-provided original amino-acid sequence; empty and absent values remain distinct.

type.description: Feature type as UniProt names it (e.g. Domain, Binding site, Modified residue, Cross-link, Lipidation, Topological domain, Chain, Mutagenesis, Non-standard residue).

featuresTotal.description: Total positional features in the entry; present only when requested.

notice.description: The merge when UniProt merged the requested accession into another entry, first; then per class: the next offset, advice to lower an exhausted offset, an empty class, or an InterPro walk that stopped short of its count.

resolvedFrom.description: PDB ID the accession was resolved from, when applicable.

truncated.description: True when at least one requested class has records past its returned page (the notice gives the next offset), or InterPro paging stopped before retrieving every membership.

items.description: A sequence feature or natural variant over a residue range.

alternativeSequences.description: Source-provided alternatives, preserving order and empty values; absence does not assert a deletion.

featureId.description: Stable UniProt feature identifier when supplied.

originalSequence.description: Source-provided original amino-acid sequence; empty and absent values remain distinct.

type.description: Feature type as UniProt names it (e.g. Domain, Binding site, Modified residue, Cross-link, Lipidation, Topological domain, Chain, Mutagenesis, Non-standard residue).

variantsTotal.description: Total natural variants in the entry; present only when requested.
